capabilities: Match notes to YAML schemas and autocomplete property values with synonym resolution
Validate the vault against schemas with a fixable report of eleven checks
Generate readable IDs and track created and modified timestamps
Convert notes between types, archiving old values instead of deleting them
Describe note body sections and Enter/Tab behavior from YAML modules
disambiguation: Not a grading or assessment tool; it defines and enforces YAML schemas for note properties.
extras: No network requests, telemetry, or account. Property-area features rely on undocumented Obsidian internals with command fallbacks. README lists untested platforms (Windows, iOS, real Android device) and points to docs/user-guide.md and docs/testing.md outside the README. Starts disabled by default until the schema is ready; mobile gets a reduced feature set.
problem: Obsidian properties have no schemas, controlled vocabularies or validation, so frontmatter drifts and errors go unchecked across a vault.
summary: YAML note-schema system that drives property autocomplete, option pickers, validation, readable IDs, timestamps and type migration from files in the vault.
